items.what: The two ankle revisions (ankle_left Y 36.500 mm vs ankle_l_v1 Y 46.498 mm) — which is current
items.answer: ankle_left / ankle_right (Y extent 36.500 mm) is the walking product's ankle; ankle_l_v1 / ankle_r_v1 (46.498 mm) is NOT an older revision but the ROLLER-SKATE variant's ankle: it appears only in robot_allcollisions_rollers.xml (both the microduck_rl and the HF simulator copies) together with rim / roller_blade / tire and without foot_* / sole_*, and its Ø2.2 vertical screw at (50.109, -5.500) matches roller_blade's own Ø1.6 pilot while ankle_left's Ø2.2 at (50.000, 4.502) matches foot_left's Ø1.6 boss at 0.000 mm residual. Upstream develop 29e887e still ships both pairs under the same names (out/sources/upstream-develop.html: ankle_left x11, ankle_l_v1 x3).

items.what: The camera distance D of the store photographs
items.evidence: MEASURED 2026-09-04 with PIL getexif().get_ifd(0x8769) and exiftool 13.x on every file in images/store/: the Shopify-served PNG/JPEGs carry ONLY ExifVersion 0210, ColorSpace 65535 and the pixel dimensions (plus Software 'imagery4' and DPI in IFD0) — no Make/Model, no FocalLength, no FocalLengthIn35mmFilm, no SubjectDistance, no maker note. The EXIF route named by the harvest is therefore closed for the store images. The PRESS-KIT JPEGs (images/press/press_*.jpg) DO carry a camera: Sony ILCE-7SM3 (full-frame 35.6 x 23.8 mm, 4240 x 2832 px native => 8.396 um pitch), FE 24-70mm F2.8 GM II, FocalLength 24 mm (closeup, screentime, watching), 37 mm (morning), 45 mm (desk), 70 mm (stickers, playtime); their Sony maker note (FocusDistance2) was stripped by Lightroom Classic 15.4.1/15.5, so D is not on file there either, but f + pitch + the head's own pixel width give D to the same 2-3 % the head width is known to, which removes the D term from any servo-scaled ratio taken on a press photograph.
items.best_supported: Keep D as a bracket [600, 2000] mm for the store images (out/head/head_fit_D600/D2000.json; it moves the front-view ratio by +-0.0105, which is not what blocks the verdict) — beat the alternative of assuming a 50 mm-equivalent product-shot lens, which would give one confident number with no source.
items.what_settles_it: The original camera files from Pollen (the Shopify upload strips EXIF), or ONE frame with a ruler in the plane of the face; for press-kit photographs, D = f x W_head / (w_px x 8.396 um) with f from the EXIF FocalLength tag (measured above) and W_head the calliper width.
items.source: PIL 11 / exiftool on images/store/*.png|jpg and images/press/*.jpg, 2026-09-04
